jd_summary: A founder-led payments startup needs one person to build and run lifecycle from signup to the tenth payment, reporting activation and early retention weekly.
priorities: retain_customers: activation and early retention reported weekly. productivity: no ops team. attract_customers: signup to tenth payment.
interviewer_said:
[I 1] Tell me about a time you improved a metric that really mattered.
[I 2] What was your part in that, specifically?
[I 3] We're a team of 40. Lifecycle reports into me, and I report to the founders.
[I 4] What questions do you have for me?

candidate_questions_sets.good:
[Q 1.1] For a lifecycle role at your stage I'd expect activation and early retention to be under the most scrutiny.
[Q 1.2] Beyond those two, how will you judge whether this hire worked after six months?
candidate_questions_sets.generic:
[Q 1.1] What's the culture like?
[Q 2.1] And who would I report to, and what does a typical day look like?
candidate_questions_sets.none: [Q 1.1] No, I think you've covered everything, thanks.

mock_transcript:
[A 1.1] I moved seven-day activation from 31 to 44 percent by fixing what happened after signup.
[A 1.2] I traced the funnel and saw people stalled on bank linking.
[A 2.1] I owned it end to end, I was the only person on lifecycle, there was no ops team.
[A 2.2] The designer owned the screen.
